notablePrerequisites:
Jhoira does not have summoning sickness.
Jhoira has at least two ingenuity counters on it.
description:
Activate Jhoira by tapping it, putting two ingenuity counters on it and putting Ancestral Statue from your hand onto the battlefield.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
